launch.description: Explicit fixed native guest/parent selection only. Exact signed C9 production-bridge runtime supplies the existing Retrieval endpoint peer14, fixed server path, public key pins and activation socket name. Requires additional signed activation retrieval-peer-directory. No unverified peer, key, deadline or ready field.

inspectionRequest.description: Canonical ASCII/integer noLF <=4096 bytes over source-owned FD4 only; actual kernel child credentials/PIDFD plus exactly one original target PIDFD right. Connection/before-send use real connection PIDFD; after-receive/after-verify use real response SCM_PIDFD. Target socket is already retained from signed C9; request cannot select any PID/path/socket.

inspectionReply.description: Canonical <=4096 bytes; actual kernel original-parent credentials/PIDFD required and no SCM_RIGHTS. Measurement identity is checked against signed runtime; this wire cannot construct host PeerMeasurement or readiness.
